d: Honey-blonde hair is styled in a shoulder-length bob with long bangs swept to the side. Bright azure eyes are wide and alert, set in a youthful, teenage face. The build is slender and athletic, dressed in a desert-tan military outfit consisting of a camouflage long-sleeved top under a brown tactical vest with pouches, matching tan cargo pants with black knee pads, and black laced boots. A large, heavy black mechanical launcher is held across the torso.
